name: Pendle
identity: Sunstone robot gunslinger; one revolver on the RIGHT hip, one marksman rifle slung across the back (stock at the right hip, barrel past the LEFT shoulder); cattleman hat; no clock motif

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/pendle.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Quick Hands
techniques.effect: Two rounds slip into the cylinder during the roll.

upgrade.name: Quick Hands II
upgrade.effect: After a full reload from empty, the first shot is a critical hit.

techniques.name: Ricochet
techniques.effect: Fan fire rounds that hit high cover bounce once.

upgrade.name: Ricochet II
upgrade.effect: A bounced round turns toward the nearest foe within 30 degrees.

techniques.name: Dead Eye
techniques.binding: during Longshot, hold still for 0.6 s
techniques.effect: The foe under the aim shows its weak point (the familiar's glint) for the next shot.

fx: scope glint on the rifle (1 drawing)

upgrade.name: Dead Eye II
upgrade.effect: A Longshot weak-point hit gives back 1 s of Longshot.

techniques.note: the upgrade extends Codex's canonical form time; needs C60's OK (#149)
